source_review.notes: Checked all six references for identity, publication or current-document status, and bounded support for nearby claims. Google SRE sources support separating response management from technical resolution, proportioning response to impact, mitigating before root-cause completion, and using product-specific user-objective severity guidance. NIST confirms SP 800-61 Revision 3 was finalized in April 2025, supersedes Revision 2, and integrates cybersecurity incident response with CSF 2.0 risk management; the CSRC glossary preserves sourced cybersecurity-incident definitions. Current PagerDuty public documentation supplies one explicitly local severity example, specificity guidance, conservative uncertainty advice, and separation between coordinated response and exact severity. All six canonical URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-09-06.
